label: A2B_tP12_92_b_a-001
title: $\alpha$-Cristobalite (SiO$_{2}$, low, $C30$) Structure
comments:
Above 530K this transforms to cubic \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_cF24_227_c_a-001}{``high'' $\beta$-cristobalite} (Pluth, 1985). 
 Space group $P4_{1}2_{1}2$ \#92 is \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/ChiralSpaceGroups#ClassII}{chiral, Sohncke Class II}, so the mirror image of this structure exists in space group $P4_{3}2_{1}2$ \#96. 
 If the silicon atoms are replaced by aluminum and phosphorous atoms the structure is very similar to the \href{current_web_home_dir/AB4C_oC24_20_a_2c_b-001}{$\alpha$-cristobalite form of AlPO$_{4}$}. 
 \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_tP12_92_b_a-002}{Paralellurite} and \href{current_web_home_dir/A2B_tP12_92_b_a-001}{$\alpha$-cristobalite ($C30$)} have the same AFLOW prototype label, A2B\_tP12\_92\_b\_a. They are generated by the same symmetry operations with different sets of parameters ({\tt --params}) specified in their corresponding CIF files. 
 More information about other SiO$_{2}$ and structures can be found in our article on \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{SiO$_{2}$ and AlPO$_{4}$}.
